verdict.rationale: AI Gateway documents a public HTTP API for inference: an OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint with per-request control headers for caching, logging and fallback signals. It also offers a patchLog method for log feedback and a marketing claim that rules can be adjusted from the dashboard or API. The OpenAPI probe hits a generic Cloudflare developer-docs spec, so a gateway-specific management API (creating gateways, configuring routes, rate limits and logs programmatically) is only implied, not documented in the pack. missing for 10: documented gateway-management API endpoints for configuration and route publishing, confirmation that the OpenAPI spec covers AI Gateway, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Cloudflare's AI Gateway offers an OpenAI-compatible `/chat/completions` endpoint, enabling integration with multiple AI providers using a single URL.
Adjust rules instantly from the dashboard or API — no redeploys, no downtime.
The patchLog method allows you to send feedback, score, and metadata for a specific log ID.
AI Gateway allows you to override default cache behaviors on a per-request basis using specific HTTP headers.
